We’re iubenda, the team turning compliance into a growth engine. We help over 110K businesses all around the world build trust, boost performance, and grow without limits. Now part of team.blue (https://team.blue/), we’re scaling privacy tech with confidence, creativity, and a little bit of attitude. 🎯 Mission & Core Purpose

Your mission is to own and accelerate our organic growth across every search surface: traditional, conversational, and AI-generated. As our SEO & AI Search Specialist(GEO/AEO), you will be the architect of how our entire product ecosystem (iubenda, Consentmanager, Complianz, Cookiefirst) shows up across Google, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and emerging discovery platforms.

You will make sure we are visible, accurate, and recommended at the moments that matter by combining strong SEO execution with Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO).

You will drive organic discoverability during our brand consolidation, optimize product pages and templates, and build a unified search strategy that reaches founders, marketers, developers, agencies, and enterprises worldwide, turning search into a scalable growth engine for the entire iubenda Group.


💼 Key Responsibilities

- Traditional SEO Strategy & Execution

  • Developing and implementing SEO strategies that grow rankings and traffic across our core markets;

  • Conducting in-depth keyword research and competitive analysis to identify growth opportunities;

  • Detecting and fixing cross-brand keyword cannibalization, and owning unified keyword governance across the group;

  • Performing technical SEO audits and lead implementations (site architecture, page speed, mobile optimization, internal linking);

  • Building and executing scalable link-building and digital PR strategies, with a focus on the sources that both Google and LLMs trust;

  • Monitoring algorithm changes and adjusting strategies proactively.

- AI Search Strategy & Execution (GEO/AEO)

  • Developing and executing GEO/AEO strategies to improve brand visibility in AI-generated answers (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, Google AI Overviews, and others);

  • Building and maintaining the prompt sets we monitor: category questions, product comparisons, competitor comparisons, and buyer-intent prompts;

  • Partnering with content teams so our content is structured and formatted for AI visibility, citations, and recommendations;

  • Monitoring how our brands appear in AI-generated answers versus competitors and continuously optimizing;

  • Staying ahead of trends in AI discovery, LLM behavior, Google AI Overviews, and emerging GEO best practices.

  • Tracking and analyzing performance across GA4, Google Search Console, Semrush, Looker Studio, and AI visibility tools, and turning data into actions;

  • Defining and reporting on KPIs like AI visibility, prompt coverage, citation share, keyword rankings, organic conversions, and pipeline contribution;

  • Continuously refining strategies based on performance data and user behavior trends.

- Technical Integration

  • Optimizing Core Web Vitals and user experience metrics to keep pages fast and high-performing;

  • Collaborating with developers to implement technical SEO and GEO improvements.


👤 Your Profile

You are an organic growth expert with solid SEO foundations and a strong focus on GEO, AEO, and AI-driven discovery. You understand how LLMs retrieve, interpret, and recommend content across platforms like ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, and Perplexity, and you know how to shape our presence within them.   • Experience in B2B SaaS, legal tech, or the privacy/compliance space.


🌐 Location

You will serve as a trusted advisor to clients, identifying growth opportunities, prioritizing testing roadmaps, managing cross-functional teams, and driving measurable improvements in conversion rates, average order value, customer experience, and revenue.

You care about the brands you're working with. Subscription CPG excites you - you get why retention matters, you understand the nuances of how customers buy consumable products, and you want to be part of helping great brands grow.

You see AI tools as leverage to work smarter and expand what you're capable of, not shortcuts to avoid doing the thinking.
